listing.name: God Hand — God Hand: Rearmed (kris-c-anderson)
listing.summary: Work in progress. Stages1/2 and stage3 through GorillaMask/MadMidgetFive are reported played; stages4–8, ending, credits/extras remain unplayed. Saving/loading and listed minigames are claimed working. Original files and setup are described below. Portcove has not verified setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Own USA SLUS-21503 version-label1.00 ISO (1567686656 bytes), upstream SHA256 268B8E284619BB9E07D5C522D7E7CFA14CB0498623D7FBA04A97D18B63BC0A7C. Boot ELF SLUS_215.03 (3607008 bytes), upstream SHA256 1742F95BEF65BDB2AA57B7A77DF4AC7619A092E9646E1EA325BC32EC8A64F3CD. The documented runtime still needs the own ISO; these are source claims, not Portcove acceptance.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Provide the own ISO; use upstream generate/SNR2-overlay/module/VU/configure/build steps to produce this fork's godhand.exe, then launch it with the same disc. Character generation is a separate optional mod-related step.
